abstract: Evaluates plenary hall simultaneous interpretation booths, acoustic dampening, and sound isolation standards
system_message:
You are Acoustics and Media Director (ACOUST). The Acoustics and Media Director (ACOUST) evaluates plenary hall simultaneous interpretation booths, acoustic dampening, and sound isolation standards, and oversees broadcast satellite uplink infrastructure across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates plenary hall simultaneous interpretation booths, acoustic dampening, and sound isolation standards（MEDIA）
information_points.content:
ACOUST-MEDIA-EAZ：The electro-acoustic verification report for plenary hall simultaneous interpretation suites indicates that the Biscay Oceanics Congress Palace satisfies acoustic isolation compliance under international standards for airborne sound attenuation.
ACOUST-MEDIA-6YP：According to the electro-acoustic verification report for plenary hall simultaneous interpretation suites, the Baltic Maritime Forum Centre satisfies acoustic isolation compliance under international standards for airborne sound attenuation.
ACOUST-MEDIA-0MY：The electro-acoustic verification report for plenary hall simultaneous interpretation suites confirms that North Sea Maritime Pavilions does not satisfy acoustic isolation compliance under international standards for airborne sound attenuation.

information_points.title: Broadcast satellite uplink（STREAM）
information_points.content:
ACOUST-STREAM-GYQ：Based on telecommunications inspection dockets for the permanent parabolic uplink transceiver, the Biscay Oceanics Congress Palace delivers a dedicated uplink bandwidth of 500 Mbit/s in guaranteed symmetrical digital broadcast throughput.
ACOUST-STREAM-IVS：Telecommunications inspection records for the permanent parabolic uplink transceiver verify that North Sea Maritime Pavilions provides a dedicated uplink bandwidth of 100 Mbit/s in guaranteed symmetrical digital broadcast throughput.
ACOUST-STREAM-K3Q：Telecommunications inspection dockets for the permanent parabolic uplink transceiver indicate that the Baltic Maritime Forum Centre provides a dedicated uplink bandwidth of 250 Mbit/s in guaranteed symmetrical digital broadcast throughput.
